title: The Hollow Beneath Redcap Hill
story: A shepherd's boy followed his dog into a crack in the hillside and came back out three days later, grey-haired and mute. The crack is still there.

notes.text: A low hall of packed earth. Roots hang from the ceiling in curtains, and the floor is churned as though something large turned around here.
The shepherd boy's dog, or what is left of it, lies curled on a heap of coins. The coins are warm.
